chalisa.cau1: O hero of the Raghus, benefactor of devotees; Lord, please hear our plea. ॥1॥
chalisa.cau2: Whoever meditates on you night and day, no other devotee is his equal. ॥2॥
chalisa.cau3: Śiva meditates on you in his mind; Brahmā and Indra do not reach your end. ॥3॥
chalisa.cau4: Victory, victory, victory to you, compassionate Lord of the Raghus; ever protect the saints. ॥4॥
chalisa.cau5: Your messenger is the hero Hanumān, whose power the three worlds know. ॥5॥
chalisa.cau6: Your staff-like arms are mighty, O compassionate one; you killed Rāvaṇa and protected the gods. ॥6॥
chalisa.cau7: You are the lord of the masterless, O Master; you are ever the helper of the humble. ॥7॥
chalisa.cau8: Even Brahmā and the others do not reach your end; O Lord, they ever sing your glory. ॥8॥
chalisa.cau9: All four Vedas bear witness that you have kept the honour of your devotees. ॥9॥
chalisa.cau10: Sarasvatī sings your virtues in her mind; Indra, lord of the gods, does not reach their end. ॥10॥
chalisa.cau11: Whoever takes your name, no one else is as blessed as he. ॥11॥
chalisa.cau12: The name of Rāma is boundless; all four Vedas have proclaimed it aloud. ॥12॥
chalisa.cau13: Gaṇapati took your name, and you made him the first to be worshipped. ॥13॥
chalisa.cau14: Śeṣa ever repeats your name; he has borne the weight of the earth on his head. ॥14॥
chalisa.cau15: That weight stays as light as a flower to him; no one reaches your end. ॥15॥
chalisa.cau16: Bharata held your name in his heart; so he was never defeated in battle. ॥16॥
chalisa.cau17: Your name shines in Śatrughna's heart; at its remembrance the enemy is destroyed. ॥17॥
chalisa.cau18: Lakṣmaṇa is obedient to you; he ever stands guard over the saints. ॥18॥
chalisa.cau19: So no one can win against him in battle, even if Yama himself joins the fight. ॥19॥
chalisa.cau20: Mahālakṣmī has taken incarnation; in every way she reduces sin to ashes. ॥20॥
chalisa.cau21: Her holy name was sung as Sītā; she showed the power of Bhuvaneśvarī. ॥21॥
chalisa.cau22: She came forth from a pot; seeing her, the moon is put to shame. ॥22॥
chalisa.cau23: She ever presses your feet; all nine treasures lie at your feet. ॥23॥
chalisa.cau24: The eighteen auspicious siddhis give themselves up to you. ॥24॥
chalisa.cau25: And whatever many other powers of lordship there are, O lord of Sītā, you alone made them. ॥25॥
chalisa.cau26: By your will, creating countless worlds takes not a moment's delay. ॥26॥
chalisa.cau27: Whoever fixes his mind on your feet surely attains liberation. ॥27॥
chalisa.cau28: Victory, victory, victory to you, Lord, whose form is light, the attributeless Brahman, undivided and incomparable. ॥28॥
chalisa.cau29: O Lord, true, true, and true to your vow, you are the true, the eternal, the indweller. ॥29॥
chalisa.cau30: Whoever sings your praise in truth surely gains the four fruits (dharma, wealth, desire and liberation). ॥30॥
chalisa.cau31: Śiva, the lord of Gaurī, has sworn a true oath that through devotion you have granted every siddhi. ॥31॥
chalisa.cau32: Listen, Rāma: you are our father; Bharata proclaimed you alone worthy of worship in the family. ॥32॥
chalisa.cau33: You, O God, are our family deity; you are our revered teacher, dear as life. ॥33॥
chalisa.cau34: Whatever may be, you alone are king. Victory, victory, victory, Lord: keep our honour. ॥34॥
chalisa.cau35: Rāma, you nourish the soul; victory, victory, victory to you, darling of Daśaratha. ॥35॥
chalisa.cau36: You who are knowledge itself, give knowledge to the heart. I bow, I bow to you; victory to you, king and lord of the world. ॥36॥
chalisa.cau37: Blessed, blessed are you, and blessed is your glory! Your name takes away anguish. ॥37॥
chalisa.cau38: The gods with their own mouths sang of you as true and pure; kettledrums sounded and conches were blown. ॥38॥
chalisa.cau39: True, true are you, true and eternal; you alone are our body, mind and wealth. ॥39॥
chalisa.cau40: Whoever recites this, knowledge dawns in his heart. ॥40॥
chalisa.cau41: His coming and going in birth and death ends; Śiva holds this word of mine true. ॥41॥
chalisa.cau42: And whatever other hope he has in his mind, he gains the fruit his heart desires. ॥42॥
chalisa.cau43: Those who meditate on you at the three times of day, and offer tulasī leaves and flowers, ॥43॥
chalisa.cau44: and set greens and leaves before you as food, gain every perfection. ॥44॥
chalisa.cau45: At the end he goes to the city of Śrī Rāma, where, being born, he is called a devotee of Hari. ॥45॥
chalisa.cau46: Śrī Haridāsa tells it and sings it: he goes to the abode of Vaikuṇṭha. ॥46॥
chalisa.do1: Whoever keeps the observance and recites this for seven days with his mind fixed on it, says Haridāsa, surely gains devotion by Hari's grace.
chalisa.do2: Whoever reads the Rāma Chālīsā with his mind fixed on Śrī Rāma's feet, whatever wish he makes in his mind is all fulfilled.
